note: The main banks: Betri Banki and Føroya Banki, the Faroe Islands' two largest banks. Føroya Banki's price list (in force from 25 September 2026) and its interest overview (in force from 23 October 2026), read in full: its four personal Mastercard credit cards, the Standard without insurance, Standard, Gold and Platinum, each with its yearly card fee from the price list (300, 500, 1,100 and 1,950 kroner; the interest overview's cost example gives 1,600 for the Platinum, which the price list's own fee is taken over). The overview gives each a nominal rate 'from 0.00% to 14.50%', its note 5 saying the lowest applies when the whole balance is paid when billed and the highest when it isn't: 14.50% a year, written so; the bill comes 15 to 42 days after a purchase, written as 42 days' grace. Cash withdrawals cost 2% (at least 50 kroner); spending in another currency is converted at the Nets rate plus 1.5% for European currencies and 2.0% for others (written as 2.0); a payment returned for want of funds costs 300 kroner. The family and business cards and the fees met only on request or misuse aren't written; no minimum payment, late or over-limit fee is stated. Betri Banki's costs page (read 30 October 2026): its Mastercard Standard, Gull and Platin Kreditt, at 300, 1,100 and 1,950 kroner a year and 14.50%, 12.50% and 10.50% a year (0% when the month's use is repaid in full), a cash withdrawal fee of 2% (at least 50 kroner), and a conversion margin of 1% in Europe and 1.5% elsewhere (written as 1.5). Its family and business cards aren't written; it states no grace period, minimum payment or penalty fees. This file kept Føroya Banki's MC Standard without insurance, read on 29 October 2026, and adds the rest. Wave 4 (30 October 2026): Norðoya Sparikassi was tried: its Mastercard Kredit page links only the card's insurance terms (from the Danish issuer Lopi Mastercard), and its rate overview and service fee pages show no card figures to a plain fetch; Suðuroyar Sparikassi's site didn't open (the proxy's tunnel failed); so no bank was added.
